problem: Unsupported and unverifiable. No source is cited for it, and nothing I could open states the status of the firm's 2025 filings. claim: Section 3: "an Old Bridge plat from July 2025"; Sources line: "Old Bridge preliminary plat dated 16 July 2025, signed for the firm by Sharif H. Aly, PE NJ Lic. 34669"
problem: The document at the cited URL is not a plat. It is an 8-page Community Impact Statement for the Brookside Villas major subdivision (Block 24303, Lot 29.11, Old Bridge), dated 16 July 2025 and signed "For the Firm" by Sharif H. Aly, PE NJ Lic. 34669. Amertech is named as preparer only in that report's reference list, as author of the "Preliminary Plat - Major Subdivision, Brookside Estates" - and that plat carries no July 2025 date anywhere I could see. So the document type and the date attribution are both wrong as stated.
fix: Say "a July 2025 Community Impact Statement for an Old Bridge subdivision that cites Amertech's preliminary plat" and describe the signature as on that report, not on the plat.

claim: Notes: "The wage page was read for the New Jersey civil engineer median ($104,660 ...); its data year was not captured, so confirm before quoting the rate"
problem: Contradicted by the page itself. The O*NET local-wages page states "Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics 2025 wage data", and industry.json records the same figure as "2025 (BLS OEWS, May 2025)". The data year was available, so the caveat is inaccurate (it errs safe but is factually wrong).
fix: Delete the caveat and cite it as BLS OEWS May 2025 data republished by O*NET, New Jersey statewide.

claim: Sources: engineerjobs.io/amertech-engineering-inc cited for "posting (5-8 years, NJ PE, prepares proposals), closed about 6 August 2026"

claim: Opening: "about ten towns with plans cycling through review rounds"
problem: The count of ten towns is confirmed, and revision cycles are confirmed for Raritan and Old Bridge, but presenting "plans cycling through review rounds" as a property of the ten-town portfolio is a generalisation from two examples and is not labelled as an inference.
fix: Add a two-word hedge, e.g. "ten towns, and the two whose files we could open show review rounds repeating".
